remedies.description: Deploy an automated carrier‑confirmation workflow (API/EDI) that triggers SH‑CAR confirmation for every pickup‑schedule change, removing the manual bottleneck.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Implementation can be scoped to a simple webhook or file‑drop integration; 225 minutes allows design, test, and cut‑over for a pilot flow.

remedies.description: Negotiate a standing‑approval window in the carrier contract (K‑SCHED) so that routine schedule shifts within the window need no per‑change confirmation.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Contract renegotiation typically exceeds the remaining 225 minutes; requires legal review and carrier sign‑off.
remedies.residual_gap: If not enacted, the root cause persists; otherwise eliminates confirmation delay entirely.
